propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, making reason-required closes and authorized bypasses unreachable over MCP

FastMCP derives JSON schemas and input models from handwritten callable signatures; undeclared payload keys are discarded before the registered callable executes, requiring both signature and forwarding layer changes
The MCP adapter forwarding logic independently omits the same parameters when delegating to rebar.transition and rebar.claim, so signature changes alone are insufficient

Repair requires adding library-compatible parameters to MCP signatures, forwarding all values unchanged to the shared core, and updating tool prose to document absent certification as the audit signal
